termsAndConditions.en: All equipment is leased. Advanced Receiver Service ($15/mo). A monthly fee of $7.00 applies for each receiver and/or Genie Mini/DIRECTV Ready TV on your account. Features Experience breathtaking HD on every connected TV Access to programming based on package selection. Blackout restrictions apply to sports programming. Program must air in HD to record in HD. | Enjoy full DVR functionality on every connected TV: Record shows; watch, rewind, fast-forward, and delete record shows; pause and rewind live TV Requires C31 Genie Mini or an RVU-enabled TV/device for each additional room. Additional fees apply. | Watch recorded or live TV on up to 4 TVs at once | Record any 5 shows at the same time, all in HD Access to programming based on package selection. Blackout restrictions apply to sports programming. Program must air in HD to record in HD. | Store all your favorite shows with up to 3x more recording capacity than cable, so you don't have to delete shows you wanted to keep to make room for new ones Based on one Genie HD DVR setup (model HR34 Advanced Whole-Home DVR only). Actual recording capacity varies based on type of programming being recorded. Program must air in HD to record in HD. Remote viewing requires a model C31 Genie Mini, H25 HD Receiver(s) or RVU-enabled TV/device in each additional room, a SWiM network and Advanced Receiver Service ($25/mo.). Visit directv.com/genie for complete details. To access HD programming, HD television equipment also required. Number of HD channels varies by package. Limit three remote viewings per Genie HD DVR (model HR34 Advanced Whole-Home DVR) at a time. | Enjoy thousands of shows and movies On Demand Actual number of TV shows and movies will vary. Additional fees required for new titles. | Watch live TV on your iPad Browsing, watching live TV, recording and remote control functionality are available to DIRECTV customers only. DIRECTV customers must have a residential home account registered on directv.com to access application. | Set your DVR from anywhere with your cell phone, iPad®, or computer DVR Scheduler requires Internet access via computer or cell phone to directv.com. Remote connections may vary. In rare instances, scheduled recording(s) may not be recognized. |
